A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the functionals considered in this study are all suitable to describe the geometries of Mn‐based complexes with potential applications to catalytic water splitting.
the most accurate density functional is MN12L, which, however, delivers low‐spin structures for Mn complexes, which are not observed experimentally.
PBE0, TPSSh and M06 are recommended for the study of Mn‐based complexes with potential applications in water oxidation catalysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of density functionals is strongly dependent on the nature of the compounds considered.
, for manganese‐based complexes of relevance for the catalytic water oxidation, the usage of B3LYP is discouraged.
the choice of a density functional for a given system should be based on the chemical properties of the compounds under study and not only on the accuracy of the functional.
